![橫幅](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Moogs_Soaring_Structure/BH_MSS_header.webp) [![Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/img/githubbutton_sm.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/D1D8LKA5N) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/869218732650688543?color=14822e&label=DISCORD&style=for-the-badge)](https://discord.com/invite/S5nffJbuvA) [![CurseForge 專案](https://img.shields.io/badge/CurseForge-projects-14822e?style=for-the-badge&logo=curseforge)](https://www.curseforge.com/members/finndog_123/projects) [![Modrinth 專案](https://img.shields.io/badge/Modrinth-projects-14822e?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/user/FinnDog_123) [![檢視結構](https://pub-24a4e0e7ea8544a5b6f73c3a23512589.r2.dev/images/c110cc09347a4f9f9de6c974f2fa35d8.png)](https://previews.moogsmods.com/soaring-structures/1.21.1/) ![總覽](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Moogs_Soaring_Structure/BH_MSS_overview.webp) 此模組支援 Forge、Fabric、NeoForge 和 Quilt！也可僅安裝於伺服器端。 Forge 支援在 1.20.4 之後已終止。 ### 關於 Moogs Soaring Structures 透過新增大量漂浮島嶼、酷炫建築及其他探索內容，為你的 Minecraft 世界注入生機、樂趣與多樣性！探索由原版方塊和實體打造的精美建築，沿途發現戰利品、敵人和村民。此模組與任何模組包相容，甚至可以僅安裝在伺服器上！ [![以 3D 形式即時瀏覽每個結構](https://pub-24a4e0e7ea8544a5b6f73c3a23512589.r2.dev/images/f8fe835413394a76b10a678afefea30f.png)](https://previews.moogsmods.com/soaring-structures/1.21.1/) 若要查看部分結構，請前往[預覽網站](https://previews.moogsmods.com/soaring-structures/1.21.1/) [![MinecraftStorage](https://imgur.com/ApCtgr7.png)](https://minecraftstorage.com/mods/mss-moogs-soaring-structures) ### 設定包 模組的每個面向皆可使用資料包自訂。內含完整說明的範本可在[此處](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/data-packs/mss-moogs-soaring-structure-config-pack)找到。 ![功能](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Moogs_Soaring_Structure/BH_MSS_features.webp) ![拼貼](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1040210/description_84b68622-1f45-4dd0-b110-ff18e67252ac.png) ### 影片
### 模組包 在此[處](https://www.modpackindex.com/modpack/finder?included_mods=61020)查看所有模組包。 ![橫幅](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Moogs_Soaring_Structure/BH_MSS_discord.webp) 獲得回覆最快且最好的方式是加入我們的 [Discord 伺服器](https://discord.gg/S5nffJbuvA)。 [![BHsponser](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Moogs_Soaring_Structure/BH_MSS_promo.webp)](https://bisecthosting.com/moogsmods?r=mrss)
